title: Brandi Liberty:
title_short: Brandi Liberty · AYH · Do You and Be You
headline: The NIWRC board treasurer is happy, her joy is being with her friends and sisters, and her one message is: live your life, find yourself, do you and be you.
story: Pure warmth. Brandi says yes, says why (her friends, her sisters, the people she loves) and then gives a personal message to the world. It is one clean take, so the cut keeps her order.
B-roll is the reception: women together, smiling and talking. It supports “sisters”. No harm on screen, no stock.

Loops: L1 “Are you happy?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:12 (“fills me with joy”). L2 “What is her one message?” opens at 0:12 and closes on “do you and be you”. Stakes: being able to find yourself in spite of obstacles.
do: Open on Brandi with the hook text <q>Are you happy?</q> already on screen at 0:00.
Keep her order: answer, source, message. Cut pauses over 0.7 s to about 0.25 s.
Name super at 00:04, lower left, 2 s: Brandi Liberty / Board Treasurer, NIWRC.
Check levels: she was told to talk loud and her peaks are high (about -2.9 dB). Pull peaks down before the loudness pass.
dont: Do not use any bite from Ardit's two Brandi cuts (Queen Cleopatra, and “on NIWRC”). Those are in Event 13 and Event 24. This cut is only Event 26.
Do not use the crew line “You're gonna have to talk loud” at the start.
Do not claim she is the first Native Queen. NIWRC has not cleared that.
Do not put a title other than the one in this plan on the super.
No Tribal affiliation on the name super. Name and title only.
